activity_summary: After the play you had been an old man in Titus, and you did not name the part. The page is still one page. The letter is still missing. You did not open the tomb to fill the evening.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused a name, and did not open the evening into a new page.

entities.name: Titus
entities.context: Mentioned in An old man, and no name

facets.activity: Came home from an old man's part in Titus

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: An old man. I am not giving him a name tonight.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The page is still one page.
